card.fact_statement: The Zhuhai Sports Center announced the immediate suspension of operations following the 2024 Zhuhai car attack.
card.source_span: The Zhuhai Sports Center issued a notice at around 9 p.m. on 11 November, announcing the immediate suspension of operations.

target_qa_variants.question: Quelle action le centre sportif de Zhuhai a-t-il annoncée à la suite de l'attaque à la voiture-bélier de Zhuhai en 2024 ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The Zhuhai Sports Center issued a notice at around 9 p.m. on 11 November, announcing the immediate suspension of operations.
